text: dsh-win-multi-bash 是面向 Windows 的 DSH shell 工具扩展，默认提供 Git Bash，并可选启用 WSL、MSYS2 和 SSH 命令工具；另有 ssh_scp 文件传输与可跨调用保留交互状态的 terminal PTY。各 shell 工具由独立执行器提供，配置可在 Web 插件页管理，并包含沙箱临时目录修复设置。适合需要在 DSH 中使用不同 Windows shell、远程命令或持续终端会话的开发者。需要 Windows、兼容版本的 DSH 与所选后端；SSH 功能需配置主机。

dsh-win-multi-bash adds Git Bash to DSH on Windows, with optional WSL, MSYS2 and SSH tools. It also offers SFTP transfers and persistent terminal sessions. Each shell has its own executor and Web settings page. Requires Windows, compatible DSH and selected backends; SSH needs configured hosts.

dsh-win-multi-bash 的功能「Git Bash 命令」：git_bash 使用独立的 GitBashExecutor 在 Windows 上运行 MSYS/Git Bash 命令；工具由插件行注册，执行器负责该方言。
dsh-win-multi-bash 的功能「SSH 命令与文件传输」：ssh_shell 通过按主机复用的 SSH 连接执行命令；同一工具行还提供 ssh_scp，可用 SFTP 传输文件或目录。
dsh-win-multi-bash 的功能「持久终端会话」：terminal 提供 open、send、read、signal、close 和 list 等操作，允许跨调用管理 PTY 会话并读取保留的输出。
dsh-win-multi-bash 的功能「Web 配置页」：插件浏览器端在 Web 插件侧栏提供配置表单，编辑插件行的配置项并保存到平台设置。
dsh-win-multi-bash 仅在 Windows 平台插入工具行；WSL、MSYS2 和 SSH 行默认需显式启用，且 SSH 主机须由部署配置提供。

dsh-win-multi-bash README · dsh-win-multi-bash：A Windows multi-bash plugin for DeepSeek Harness. **`git_bash`** (Git for Windows / MSYS) is on by default. **`wsl_bash`** (WSL), **`msys2_bash`** (MSYS2 UCRT64), **`ssh_shell`** (pooled SSH channels, key-only, many hosts) and **`ssh_scp`** (SFTP transfer on the same row) are opt-in. **`terminal`** keeps a real PTY session alive between calls.

dsh-win-multi-bash README · dsh-win-multi-bash：Every dialect owns its own executor, and **no tool registers as `ctx.shell`** — that seat stays with the base bundle's pwsh, so pwsh behaves exactly as it does without this plugin.

dsh-win-multi-bash README · Tools：| Tool | Backend | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `git_bash` | Git for Windows (MSYS) | **On by default**; owns a `GitBashExecutor` |
| `wsl_bash` | WSL Linux | **Opt-in**; owns a `WslBashExecutor`; its first load probes the distro |
| `msys2_bash` | MSYS2 UCRT64 | **Opt-in**; owns a `Msys2BashExecutor`; MSYS2's own `$MSYSTEM` and `pacman` |
| `ssh_shell` | Remote (SSH) | **Opt-in**; owns a `SshShellExecutor`; one pooled connection per host, one channel per call |
| `ssh_scp` | Remote (SSH) | **Opt-in with `ssh_shell`**; SFTP file/tree transfer on the same executor and pooled connection; foreground only |
| `terminal` | any of the above | Persistent PTY sessions: `open` / `send` / `read` / `signal` / `close` / `list` |
| `pwsh` | dsh's own | Untouched; served by the base bundle's `pwsh-sandbox` row |

dsh-win-multi-bash README · Tools：Only `git_bash` and `terminal` ship on; the other three rows are opt-in. `git_bash` often runs unconfined — see [Sandbox behavior](https://github.com/Dinosaur-MC/dsh-win-multi-bash/blob/main/docs/sandbox.md).

dsh-win-multi-bash README · Requirements：- dsh `0.1.7-rc.2` through `0.2.x` — the window `package.json`'s `engines.dsh` declares. A newer dsh refuses this plugin.
- Windows, and a dsh deployment that provides the published `@deepseek-ai` base packages.
- Git Bash and/or WSL and/or MSYS2 only for the backends you enable; a missing backend never affects pwsh.
- For `ssh_shell` / `ssh_scp`: key-only access under `sshShell.hosts`, host keys in `known_hosts`.
- Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` (the range this package declares), and `pnpm` for installation.

dsh-win-multi-bash README · Install：Install through `dsh plugin`, the pnpm forwarder: it applies this package's own `cordis.patch.yml` bundle layer, which inserts the rows.

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-win-multi-bash                    # npm package (recommended)
dsh plugin --profile web add github:@Dinosaur-MC/dsh-win-multi-bash # GitHub source
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-win-multi-bash                 # remove
```

dsh-win-multi-bash README · Install：Requires `pnpm`. The bundle layer is assembled at boot, so **restart `dsh web`** for a change to take effect. Do not also hand-write the same rows into the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`: the loader rejects duplicate entry ids.

dsh-win-multi-bash README · Quick start：- **`git_bash`** is ready after install. It runs a fresh MSYS bash per call; `workdir` accepts native, MSYS (`/c/...`) and WSL automount (`/mnt/c/...`) forms.
- **`wsl_bash` / `msys2_bash`**: enable `win-mb-tool-wsl` / `win-mb-tool-msys2` on the Plugins page. Pin `wslBash.wslDistro` or `msys2Bash.bashPath` only when discovery is not enough.
- **`ssh_shell`**: enable `win-mb-tool-ssh` and add hosts under `sshShell.hosts` (`alias`, `host`, `user`, `keyPath`; `port` / `startupCommand` / `default` as needed). A call names an alias (or omits it when one host is `default`); no hosts refuses every call. Key-only auth, strict host keys — see the [migration notes](https://github.com/Dinosaur-MC/dsh-win-multi-bash/blob/main/docs/configuration.md). Hosts default to `approval: session`: one prompt per session through a dedicated card; `trusted` never asks.
- **`ssh_scp`**: the same row does transfers — `action: "upload" | "download"`, `localPath` (inside the workspace unless `danger-full-access`; checked lexically, symlinks are not resolved), `remotePath` (absolute POSIX; `/C:/...` on Windows OpenSSH), `recursive` for trees, `timeoutMs` (default 5 min).

dsh-win-multi-bash README · Design at a glance：- **Honest facts, not guesses.** A successful confined run says `denied: false`; a failed one matching the backend's denial dialect says `denied: true`; a failed one matching nothing says no `denied` at all. An unwrapped run says `unconfined: true`. A remote SSH run reports `sandbox: { mode, remote: true }`.
- **Platform-native calls.** Our shell tools use the platform's shell card; `ssh_scp` uses the generic row. See [Conversation rows](https://github.com/Dinosaur-MC/dsh-win-multi-bash/blob/main/docs/conversation-rows.md).
- **One connection per host, one channel per call.** `ssh_shell` reuses a pooled ssh2 client and gives every call its own exec channel — isolated, parallel-safe, cancellable. `ssh_scp` transfers share that pooled client, one SFTP session per transfer.
- **One declaration per dialect.** A dialect is one executor file plus one registry declaration; the tool modules, prompt membership, patch rows, config partition, package exports and client rows are derived from it. A declaration that does not hold together throws at load. See [Architecture](https://github.com/Dinosaur-MC/dsh-win-multi-bash/blob/main/docs/architecture

dsh-win-multi-bash README · Verification：```bash
npm ci                  # once: the pinned 0.2.1-rc.2 dev runtime
pnpm test               # boot a composition; run real commands; a verdict
pnpm run test:audit     # the full audit suite
DSH_AUDIT_SSH_HOST=ubuntu_tx node smoke/prepare.mjs audit   # optional live SSH

Both entries are development tools: the published tarball ships no `smoke/`. `pnpm test` fails on a missing tool, a wrong description, a lost `ctx.shell` seat or a failed command; the audit announces and counts its skips.

dsh-win-multi-bash README · Layout：```
dsh-win-multi-bash/
├── package.json            # dsh.bundle + dsh.client + engines.dsh; exports for every tool subpath
├── cordis.patch.yml        # the composition wiring (documented inline)
├── lib/                    # plain ESM implementation (no build step)

`docs/` and `smoke/` are repository-only; `npm pack` ships only the files listed in `package.json`.
